title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
author: arXiv cs.AI
summary: The paper presents a RAG-based methodology for integrating context-specific knowledge into LLMs, aimed at reducing misinformation in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It offers modeling and analysis to demonstrate how domain-grounded retrieval improves factual accuracy and reliability of responses in business settings.
